visual_appeal: The NOW PLAYING strip has a hole in the middle. The sentence 'No rested XP: kills give normal XP' floats centred with no bar. Put back the 10 px empty rest bar (track #1a1410, red #d03a2a 1 px edge) at x 390-640 and move the sentence under it at 12 px, so the strip has the same columns as the rows below it.
The RESTING chip glyph (12 px) renders as a brown smudge on both themes. Use a crisp 2-tone glyph: a bed or Zzz outline in the state orange #f39a2b on transparent. Do not use a cropped item texture.

Hero right column: '1.5' is about 34 px and 'LEVELS BANKED' about 10 px. 'Then Le Bankken, full in 19h' at about 10 px is too faint to read as information. Raise it to 12 px in #c9b892 and add 6 px above it.
play_next_clarity: The runner-up line is the least readable text in the hero. Move it under the action line, right-aligned before View details, at 12 px: 'After: Le Bankken · full 23:12'. Or give it 12 px and a #d8c79a tint where it is now.

The action line 'First: hearth Le Jette to an inn. Then: play Le Dette.' is 14 px cream, the same weight as body text. Make it 15 px. Split it into two clauses with a 10 px gap and a 12 px hearthstone icon before 'hearth', so the order of steps reads without colour.

Le Dette's portrait has a green ring, yet it is the full character. Add a 16 px 'FULL' corner tag (green #3fcf5a on #0c1a0f) at the portrait's lower right, opposite the race badge, so #1's state reads at a glance and not only from the rail.
state_colours: The NEARLY FULL chip glyph (a yellow star) and the RESTING glyph differ in visual weight. Put all four chip glyphs on a 12x12 grid with a 1.5 px stroke and the same optical size.
Timeline night bands still read slate blue, about #343c4c. Use #2a2a2c at 70% so they do not compete with the blue ElvUI buttons or tint the orange lanes.
The red lane for Jacques Hammer looks like the other long lanes apart from its hue. Add a 1 px dashed red end cap and the text 'Outside · 4x slower' at 11 px under the date in the AFTER 48H column.
character_identity: Card scene 06: the bar text wraps badly ('0.1 of a level / banked.'). Widen the text box to the full 390 px card width, or rewrite it as two deliberate lines: 'Resting at Thunder Bluff · 0.1 level banked' and 'Full in 9d · Thu 3 Dec, 05:00'.
Badge discs at 19 px in rows (Le Jedde's draenei badge) blur into the class icon edge. Increase the overlap offset by 3 px outward and add a 1 px #0a0806 gap ring between disc and portrait.
The level medallion '11' on the card sits close to the class badge and reads as a second badge. Move it to the top-left of the portrait, or into the meta line.
default_theme: The default close button is a bare 'X' letterform in a bronze box, which looks placeholder. Use a drawn 2 px cross glyph at 10 px in #f0e2c0, centred, with a 1 px #c9a24a rim and a #3a2a18 to #261a10 vertical gradient.
Row alternation in the default theme (brown vs darker brown) is about 4% luminance. Raise it to 7%, or drop alternation and use 1 px #4a3a24 separators as in the ElvUI theme.
The title-bar orb icon next to 'Rested Leveling' is muddy at its size. Use a 16 px crisp inn or moon glyph, or remove it.
elvui_wc3_fit: The host Options (image 3) uses gold-yellow labels, about #ffd100, on near-black. Your option labels and section heads are cream. Use the host yellow for checkbox labels and keep section heads cream caps, so the panel sits beside Blizzard's skinned pages.
ElvUI host buttons are 22 px tall with centred 12 px text. Your 'Move notifications' button is wider and heavier than any host button. Cap it at 160x22.
Tab labels ROSTER and TIMELINE with an underline are a third control style. Under ElvUI, use the host's tab look: a 1 px border box with the active tab filled #2a2a2a.
alerts_ux: Move mode (scene 04) still shows the warning triangle on the 'Esc menu card' placeholder. The notes say the Esc card now uses an inn icon. Each placeholder must show its real alert's icon.

Banner vs Esc card (scene 05): titles, layout, Next row and Details button are nearly the same, and the Esc card's inn icon is an unreadable blob at about 20 px. Give the Esc card a 24 px clear inn glyph, a 2-line max body and no Details button, so it differs in shape and not only in icon.

Banner hierarchy: 'Le Jette is outside a rest area.' and the hearth instruction look the same cream. Make the situation line #a89a80 at 12 px and the instruction #f2e6c8 at 13 px, so the change is visible.

Toast: the amber trigger line at 12 px sits above an amber-cream headline of nearly the same hue. Make the trigger #c98a3a at 11 px caps-free and the headline #f2e6c8 at 14 px, so the two lines read as cause and then action.
Logout placeholder: the dark block on the right reads as broken, even if it is skin art. Size the placeholder to the banner's real width in scene 05 so the skin lays out the same as the banner.
readability: Row meta at about 11 px ('Lv 8 · Goldshire inn · 3d ago') is the minimum, and the dividers are hard to see. Use 12 px with the '·' at #7a6c55.
Timeline lanes 3-5 all say 'Full Wed 2 Dec'. Add the time ('Wed 2 Dec 01:36') so the lanes can be told apart. The compact tip already has these times.
Legend counts ('1 full', '1 nearly full') at 11 px on the band: raise them to 12 px and add 14 px between groups.
layout_polish: Options: the gap above 'WINDOW AND DISPLAY' is about 6 px, while APPEARANCE and ACCOUNTS have about 16 px. Use 18 px above every heading and 8 px below it.
Options: there is about 120 px of dead space below About. Reduce the panel's min height, or move About into a footer line at 11 px #8a7d66.
Card: the stage leaves about 200x90 px empty left of the portrait under the speech bubble. Move the name/state block up beside the portrait, or centre the bubble vertically against the portrait.
Card: the rest bar is 10 px tall and stops about 40 px short of the right edge. Make it 14 px and full width, 12 px insets on both sides.
Timeline: the 100% label and the 'Full now' dot touch the NOW line. Add 6 px of padding after the percent column.
delight: Use the breathing accent on #1 for one more small moment: when a character crosses into full while the window is open, give a single 600 ms shimmer across its bar (off under Reduce motion).
Rotate speech lines with class and race flavour in rows on hover (a tooltip quip). Today only the hero and card have personality.
The zzZ on resting cards is good. Give the timeline 'Full now' dot a tiny star or tick glyph instead of a plain green circle.

overall_notes: This is a large step up from the real v1.1.2 baseline. The hierarchy is clear, the state colour language is consistent, the badges now separate the rows, and there is one button family per theme. The timeline and compact tooltip are the strongest pieces. It is still not 9-level because of polish gaps a demanding user will see: the hollow NOW PLAYING strip, a smudgy RESTING glyph, banner and Esc card alerts that are near twins (and a move-mode placeholder whose icon contradicts the notes), awkward text wrapping on the card, and uneven spacing and host-mismatched label colour in Options. Fix those and this is an 8.5-9 addon.
